title: ClaimCandidate
description: HAL output. Turns best insight candidates into explicit, testable claim candidates. HAL may frame a claim but cannot validate truth.

claim_sentence.description: The claim in one falsifiable sentence. HAL demands precision.

source_refs.description: Original source pointers from the insight lineage.

evidence_refs.description: Existing artifacts, files, or data that partially support the claim. May be empty.

evidence_requirement.description: What evidence would fully establish or refute the claim. Concrete and specific.

test_or_review_path.description: How to test or review this claim. A concrete method: unit test, audit, replay, peer review, experiment.

risk_if_wrong.description: What is the blast radius if this claim is wrong and admitted? Grounds MAYOR's review.

hal_reason.description: HAL's case for why this insight deserves ClaimCandidate status. Why it's testable enough.

derived_from_insight_id.description: The InsightCandidate this was framed from.

claim_status.description: Always CLAIM_CANDIDATE. Not a validated claim.

actor.description: Always HAL. Only HAL emits ClaimCandidates.
